prompt: This photorealistic photo shows a rugged pirate ship deck under a stormy sky. On the left, a bearded captain in a tattered coat grips the ship's wheel, his eyes fixed on the horizon. Next to him, a parrot with bright green feathers perches on a rope, squawking loudly. In the center, two sailors struggle together to pull a heavy anchor chain, their muscles tense with effort. One wears a striped shirt, while the other is shirtless, revealing tattoos on his arms. To the right, a young cabin boy carries a bucket of water, spilling some onto the wet wooden planks. A large cannon sits nearby, its metal surface gleaming with rain. In the foreground, a coiled rope lies tangled near a crate of supplies. Raindrops streak across the lens, adding realism to the scene. The lighting is dim and moody, with flashes of lightning illuminating the clouds in the background. Waves crash against the hull, visible through the gaps in the railing. The captain shouts orders, pointing toward the distant storm. The sailors look toward him, responding to his command. The texture of the wet wood and soaked clothing is highly detailed. The overall atmosphere is tense and adventurous, capturing the peril of life at sea.
